text: 会议审议通过《中华人民共和国审计法实施条例（修订草案）》。会议指出，要以此次条例修订为契机，进一步深化审计改革，压实审计整改责任，加强财政收支监督检查，完善政策实施机制，持续提升审计监督效能。（央视）
text_en: The meeting reviewed and approved the 'Implementation Regulations of the Audit Law of the People's Republic of China (Revised Draft)'. The meeting noted that this revision should be taken as an opportunity to further deepen audit reform, tighten audit rectification responsibilities, strengthen supervision and inspection of fiscal revenues and expenditures, improve policy implementation mechanisms, and continuously enhance the effectiveness of audit supervision. (CCTV)
